_schema_doc: WP-02 pinned atol baseline (2026-08-09, updated 2026-08-11 for encoder.conv order fix). Consumed by `crates/vokra-models/tests/sbv2_parity_atol_calibration.rs::atol_values_are_pinned_against_baseline_drift` to detect silent drift (>50% in either direction) of any `crates/vokra-models/src/sbv2/parity.rs::PER_TENSOR_ATOL` value against its pinned baseline. The updater `tools/parity/sbv2_atol_updater.py` proposes edits to this file plus the code side; owner reviews and commits both TOGETHER per the memory `feedback-honest-parity-atol` redundant-recording rule. See `docs/adr/sbv2-parity-atol.md` §5 for the empirical-measurement cycle this file participates in, and this crate's `sbv2_parity_atol_calibration.rs` test's rustdoc for the RED->GREEN->REFACTOR walkthrough.

bert_hidden_ja.measurement_source: M1 iMac local run (`cargo test --release parity_sbv2_real`), post encoder.conv order fix (crates/vokra-bert/src/deberta_v2.rs `EncoderConv::forward` + `DebertaV2Encoder::forward` invocation-after-layer-0)
bert_hidden_ja.note: Pre-fix (2026-08-10): 10.83 with encoder.conv completely absent; encoder.conv wired at wrong position → 9.99. HF `DebertaV2Encoder.forward` fires encoder.conv AFTER layer[0] (not before), with conv input = pre-layer-0 embed_ln output and residual = post-layer-0 output. Fix reduced |Δ| by ~440× to 0.0247. Bound set to measured × 2.02 = 0.05 per `feedback-honest-parity-atol` (`1.5-2×` margin over measured floor). Cross-arch (Linux glibc libm) may nudge this; CI will measure and this may need bumping.

bert_hidden_en.note: Same derivation as `bert_hidden_ja` — DeBERTa v3 is v2's shared-position variant, not a deeper stack. v3 does NOT ship encoder.conv (`conv_kernel_size` unset), so the 2026-08-11 encoder.conv order fix does not affect this path; the pre-fixture bound stays 0.02 pending its own real-fixture measurement.

bert_bridge_out.measurement_source: M1 iMac local run (post encoder.conv order fix); cascade of bert_hidden_ja through the SBV2 bridge conv (`enc_p.bert_proj_ja`).
bert_bridge_out.note: Not previously overridden; fell through to ATOL_DEFAULT=0.01 with `UnmeasuredDefault` status. With encoder.conv fix, bert_hidden_ja tightened → cascades cleanly through bridge conv (kernel=1 pointwise, so amplification is bounded by weight-norm × input-magnitude). Bound set to measured × 2.13 = 0.07.

mel_hidden.measurement_source: M1 iMac local run (post encoder.conv order fix); cascade of bert_bridge_out through the SBV2 text encoder into the mel path.
mel_hidden.note: Not previously overridden; fell through to ATOL_DEFAULT=0.01. Numerically identical to bert_bridge_out because the additive-broadcast injection at the T_text axis preserves per-position |Δ| within the max reduction. Bound set to measured × 2.13 = 0.07 for consistency with bert_bridge_out.

sdp_sample.note: SDP `.max(1)` boundary + ordinary flow-stack rounding; requires matching PRNG algorithm + seed on both sides for the comparison to be meaningful (currently satisfied by `RngMode::PhiloxRngEnginePyTorchParity` default). See `PER_TENSOR_ATOL`'s `"sdp_sample"` rustdoc block for the 2026-08-08 torch.randn parity Steps 1-10 landing note.

z_latent.measurement_source: M1 iMac local run (post encoder.conv order fix); flow inverse cumulative rounding + affine-scale amplification.
z_latent.note: Pre-fix (2026-08-10): 5.634 with encoder.conv absent; 4.427 with encoder.conv wired at wrong position. Fix reduced |Δ| by ~157× to 0.0359 as the encoder.conv improvement cascaded through the entire flow-inverse chain (mel_hidden → z_latent). Bound set to measured × 2.23 = 0.08 per `feedback-honest-parity-atol`. Previous theoretical bound 0.03 is now insufficient — the actual measurement exceeds it because the flow's affine-scale amplification is real and the encoder.conv fix only exposed it (did not create it).

waveform.measurement_source: CI run 31303426623 (Linux ubuntu-latest AVX2 + glibc libm)
waveform.note: Bit-exact libm follow-up documented as deferral in `docs/adr/sbv2-libm-strategy.md` §4; do not tighten below 1.0 without pinning libm bit-exact across archs. STATUS UPDATE 2026-08-09: SBV2 hot-path libm swap (WP-05, ~40h CC) has been ACCEPTED as a scoped exception — see `docs/adr/sbv2-libm-strategy.md` §3.2.1. Workspace-wide vendoring stays rejected (§3.1/§3.2); an in-tree hot-path swap (HiFi-GAN `tanh`/`sqrt` = WP-08 dominant, plus WP-10/WP-11/WP-12) is now authorized. WP-06 → WP-07 → WP-08 land order; once WP-08 measurement lands, the `1.5` bound is expected to tighten toward ~1e-3 (Kokoro-tier) via the `docs/adr/sbv2-parity-atol.md` §5 Revert 手続き (5-point simultaneous update).
